title: Defence Housing Authority Peshawar Amendment Act 2010

sections.shortTitle: Defence Housing Authority Peshawar Amendment Act 2010
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 2010
ACT II OF 2010
DEFENCE HOUSING AUTHORITY PESHAWAR
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act to amend the Defence Housing Authority
Peshawar Act, 2009.
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary,
23rd January, 2010]
No. PA/N.-W.F.P./Bills/2010/2773. dated
23-1-2010.---The Defence Housing Authority Peshawar
(Amendment) Bill, 2010 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of
North-West Frontier Province on 16th January, 2010 and assented to by the
Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 9th January, 2010 is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the North-West Frontier
Province.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend the Defence Housing Authority Peshawar Act, 2009 (N.-W.F.P. Act
No. X of 2009), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
(2) It is hereby enacted
as follows:
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Defence
Housing Authority Peshawar (Amendment) Act, 2010.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

(2) It is hereby enacted
as follows:
3. Amendment of
section 4 of N.-W.F.P. Act No. X of 2009.---In the said Act, in section 4,-
(a) in subsection (1), for clause (g), the following shall be
substituted, namely:
"(g) two co-opted Members, to be nominated by the
Chairman.";
(b) in subsection (3), for clause (d), the following shall be
substituted, namely:
"(d) two co-opted members, to be nominated by the President;
and"; and
(c) after subsection (4), the following shall be inserted,
namely:
"(4A) The co-opted members shall be members for a period not
exceeding two years at a time and shall not have the right
to vote.".
